event_detail: Kettle still on the counter right of the stove at 27-32 s. The empty gripper moves over the stove and pan (27.2 s), lifts up (28.8-30.4 s) and swings back high above the kettle (32.0 s) without picking it.
evidence: The right shoulder view shows the kettle standing on the counter right of the stove in every frame. The wrist view shows the pan and knobs at 27.2/28.8 s, then the kettle seen from high above at 30.4/32.0 s, with nothing in the gripper. Only the pan is on the stove. The robot may be starting a new approach to the kettle, but no progress is made in this window.
